# MMXN (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 8 measured or mapped, 8 mapped, 0 excluded, 0 unmapped, 20 not measured

## Measurements

MMXN.Amp | current | unit A | mmxn.amp
MMXN.Vol | voltage | unit V | mmxn.vol
MMXN.Watt | active-power | unit W | mmxn.watt
MMXN.VolAmpr | reactive-power | unit VAr | mmxn.volampr
MMXN.VolAmp | apparent-power | unit VA | mmxn.volamp
MMXN.PwrFact | power-factor | unit 1 | mmxn.pwrfact
MMXN.Imp | impedance | unit ohm | mmxn.imp
MMXN.Hz | frequency | unit Hz | mmxn.hz
